title: Tiny, cute armchair
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- backrest -->
  <rect x="22" y="18" width="56" height="42" rx="14" fill="#e85a5a"/>
  <!-- backrest highlight -->
  <rect x="28" y="24" width="44" height="30" rx="10" fill="#f47c7c"/>
  <!-- seat cushion -->
  <rect x="20" y="50" width="60" height="22" rx="8" fill="#f0a040"/>
  <!-- seat top highlight -->
  <rect x="25" y="53" width="50" height="10" rx="5" fill="#f5c060"/>
  <!-- left armrest -->
  <rect x="10" y="38" width="16" height="30" rx="8" fill="#d94a4a"/>
  <!-- left armrest top -->
  <rect x="11" y="37" width="14" height="10" rx="5" fill="#f47c7c"/>
  <!-- right armrest -->
  <rect x="74" y="38" width="16" height="30" rx="8" fill="#d94a4a"/>
  <!-- right armrest top -->
  <rect x="75" y="37" width="14" height="10" rx="5" fill="#f47c7c"/>
  <!-- skirt/body front -->
  <rect x="20" y="68" width="60" height="10" rx="4" fill="#c43c3c"/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <rect x="24" y="78" width="8" height="12" rx="3" fill="#8b5a2b"/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <rect x="68" y="78" width="8" height="12" rx="3" fill="#8b5a2b"/>
  <!-- left foot -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="90" rx="7" ry="3" fill="#a0703a"/>
  <!-- right foot -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="90" rx="7" ry="3" fill="#a0703a"/>
  <!-- seat button tufting -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="61" r="2.5" fill="#d98830"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="61" r="2.5" fill="#d98830"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="61" r="2.5" fill="#d98830"/>
  <!-- little cushion heart -->
  <path d="M50 34 c-3 -4 -10 -2 -10 3 c0 5 10 10 10 10 c0 0 10 -5 10 -10 c0 -5 -7 -7 -10 -3 z" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
</svg>
